data.geometry: 192x32 only (no domain-size axis in the deposit)
data.grid: frames = grid_mult * 500 (log-spaced), fixed absolute-time grid; run alive at t if t < t_fix
data.ladder: 13 U_d/s_d rungs (128 runs each; 96 at U/s=10 from the Lambda=1e-3 validation arm) = 1,632 runs, 0 censored

estimators.bootstrap: run-level (whole trajectories resampled), 600 replicates absolute-time / 400 normalized / 400 windowed
